summary: Phase 3 implementation is complete. All 5 tasks are marked done. drizzle-orm 0.45.2 installed (root override 0.45.2), drizzle-kit bumped to ^0.31.7 (installed 0.31.10, justified: no stable 0.32.x exists on npm), drizzle-zod ^0.7.0 installed (0.7.1). findings: test-strategy.md §7 Phase 4 gate says 'drizzle-kit 0.32+' but the Phase 3 test asserts >=0.31.7. Documentation inconsistency to be resolved in Phase 4 when updating test-strategy.md with the actual Drizzle version.

The integration-gates test only asserts preconditions (config, scripts, journal, version pins). This is deferred to Phase 4 per the plan structure (Phase 4 owns 'pnpm --filter @reading-advantage/db migrate against fresh DB').
